theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨t, Tr.choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨t, Tr.choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t, ht, .bisim hb⟩
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t, ht, .bisim hb⟩

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht
    case left.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t, Tr.choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
    case right.choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t, Tr.choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
    all_goals exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h => grind [IsBisimulation, ChoiceBisim]

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩

  cases hr with

    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      first

  | bisim h =>
    have := Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ
    grind only [ChoiceBisim.bisim]

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h

  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht

  all_goals
    unfold lts at *
    grind only [→ h.follow_fst, → h.follow_snd, ChoiceBisim.bisim, Tr.choiceL]

    all_goals first | exact Tr.choiceL | exact id | apply h.follow_fst | apply h.follow_snd
    all_goals assumption

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht
    case choiceR ht => use s', ht.choiceR, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)
  all_goals
    apply Exists.imp (fun _ => And.imp (by first | exact Tr.choiceL | exact id)
      ChoiceBisim.bisim)
    apply_rules [h.follow_fst, h.follow_snd]
